title: AIDRA — Compression Benchmarks
description: Compressed model variants against their FP32 baseline. Runtime panels use triplets only: {FP32 baseline, variant, constraint profile} on the same scene (I-MOD-1). Accuracy is compared on the same validation set with the same matching parameters (I-MOD-2); the tolerated loss is 5 mAP points (I-MOD-3). Rejected variants are kept and labelled, never removed. Cue runs (AOI crops) are excluded.

list.name: profile
list.label: Constraint Profile
list.description: Hardcoded list (custom) — public dashboards do not run query-type template vars.

panels.title: Compression Triplets: Variant vs FP32, Same Scene and Profile (I-MOD-1)
panels.description: One row per {variant, profile} with at least one scene also run by FP32 under that profile; averages are over those shared scenes only. speedup = FP32 time / variant time. A variant with no shared scene shows 'NO TRIPLET' and its runs are not evidence. registry_status and rejection_reason come from models_registry: rejected variants stay listed (I-MOD-3).

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
    SELECT
        image_hash,
        constraint_profile AS profile,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(compression_technique, ''), 'none') AS technique,
        AVG(inference_ms) AS inf_ms,
        AVG(peak_ram_mb) AS ram_mb,
        AVG(num_detections) AS dets,
        COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM execution_log
    WHERE trigger_type <> 'cue'
        AND status = 'success'
        AND image_hash <> 'pending'
        AND (notes IS NULL OR notes NOT LIKE '%methodology:pre-321de6b%')
        AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR constraint_profile = '$profile')
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
pairs AS (
    -- I-MOD-1: a variant is only compared with FP32 runs of the SAME scene
    -- (image_hash) under the SAME constraint profile.
    SELECT
        v.technique, v.profile, v.image_hash,
        v.n AS v_n, b.n AS b_n,
        v.inf_ms AS v_inf, b.inf_ms AS b_inf,
        v.ram_mb AS v_ram, b.ram_mb AS b_ram,
        v.dets AS v_dets, b.dets AS b_dets
    FROM runs v
    JOIN runs b
      ON b.image_hash = v.image_hash AND b.profile = v.profile AND b.technique = 'none'
    WHERE v.technique <> 'none'
)
,
variants AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(compression_technique, ''), 'none') AS technique
    FROM execution_log
    WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(compression_technique, ''), 'none') <> 'none'
),
reg AS (
    SELECT compression_technique AS technique, status, rejection_reason
    FROM models_registry
    WHERE compression_technique <> 'none'
)
SELECT
    va.technique AS variant,
    COALESCE(reg.status, 'unregistered') AS registry_status,
    CASE WHEN p.profile IS NULL THEN 'NO TRIPLET' ELSE 'triplet' END AS evidence,
    p.profile,
    COUNT(p.image_hash) AS shared_scenes,
    SUM(p.v_n) AS variant_runs,
    SUM(p.b_n) AS fp32_runs,
    ROUND((AVG(p.b_inf) / 60000.0)::numeric, 1) AS fp32_min,
    ROUND((AVG(p.v_inf) / 60000.0)::numeric, 1) AS variant_min,
    ROUND((AVG(p.b_inf) / NULLIF(AVG(p.v_inf), 0))::numeric, 1) AS speedup,
    ROUND(AVG(p.b_ram)::numeric, 0) AS fp32_ram_mb,
    ROUND(AVG(p.v_ram)::numeric, 0) AS variant_ram_mb,
    ROUND(AVG(p.b_dets)::numeric, 0) AS fp32_detections,
    ROUND(AVG(p.v_dets)::numeric, 0) AS variant_detections,
    ROUND((100.0 * (AVG(p.v_dets) - AVG(p.b_dets)) / NULLIF(AVG(p.b_dets), 0))::numeric, 1) AS delta_detections_pct,
    COALESCE(reg.rejection_reason, '') AS rejection_reason
FROM variants va
LEFT JOIN pairs p ON p.technique = va.technique
LEFT JOIN reg ON reg.technique = va.technique
GROUP BY va.technique, reg.status, reg.rejection_reason, p.profile
ORDER BY (p.profile IS NULL), va.technique, p.profile

panels.title: Accuracy vs FP32 on the Same Validation Set (I-MOD-2 / I-MOD-3)
panels.description: Each validated variant against the FP32 baseline measured on the same dataset with the same pipeline path, matching mode, thresholds, YOLO input and fusion mode (latest run of each). delta_map_pts = variant - baseline, in mAP points; a loss above 5 points rejects the variant (I-MOD-3). 'NO BASELINE' = no FP32 run on that dataset with those parameters, so the row is not evidence. The YOLO-only rows are low in absolute terms (about 0.03 mAP on xView3): that is the detector alone; the pipeline output is the CFAR + YOLO union row.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(NULLIF(compression_technique, ''), 'none') AS technique
    FROM validation_runs
),
ensemble_baseline(variant_model, baseline_model) AS (
    VALUES ('aidra-cfar+vesseltracker-sar-yolov8-int8-static-union', 'aidra-cfar+yolo-union')
),
variant_runs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (model_name, model_version, dataset, pipeline_path) *
    FROM v
    WHERE technique <> 'none'
    ORDER BY model_name, model_version, dataset, pipeline_path, created_at DESC
),
reg AS (
    SELECT compression_technique AS technique, status
    FROM models_registry
    WHERE compression_technique <> 'none'
)
SELECT
    vr.model_name || ':' || vr.model_version AS variant,
    COALESCE(reg.status, 'unregistered') AS registry_status,
    vr.dataset,
    ROUND(b.map_at_iou::numeric, 4) AS fp32_map,
    ROUND(vr.map_at_iou::numeric, 4) AS variant_map,
    ROUND(((vr.map_at_iou - b.map_at_iou) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS delta_map_pts,
    ROUND(b.pd_recall::numeric, 3) AS fp32_pd,
    ROUND(vr.pd_recall::numeric, 3) AS variant_pd,
    ROUND(b.far_per_km2::numeric, 4) AS fp32_far_km2,
    ROUND(vr.far_per_km2::numeric, 4) AS variant_far_km2,
    CASE
        WHEN b.id IS NULL THEN 'NO BASELINE'
        WHEN (b.map_at_iou - vr.map_at_iou) * 100 > 5 THEN 'REJECT (> 5 pts)'
        ELSE 'within budget'
    END AS verdict
FROM variant_runs vr
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM v b
    WHERE b.technique = 'none'
      AND b.model_name = COALESCE(
            (SELECT baseline_model FROM ensemble_baseline WHERE variant_model = vr.model_name),
            regexp_replace(vr.model_name, '-int8-(dynamic|static)$', ''))
      AND b.dataset = vr.dataset
      AND b.pipeline_path IS NOT DISTINCT FROM vr.pipeline_path
      AND b.match_mode = vr.match_mode
      AND b.iou_threshold = vr.iou_threshold
      AND b.confidence_threshold = vr.confidence_threshold
      AND (b.params_json ->> 'yolo_input') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (vr.params_json ->> 'yolo_input')
      AND (b.params_json ->> 'fusion_mode') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (vr.params_json ->> 'fusion_mode')
    ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) b ON true
LEFT JOIN reg ON reg.technique = vr.technique
ORDER BY (b.id IS NULL), vr.dataset, vr.model_name

panels.title: Inference Time: Variant vs FP32 on the Same Scenes (minutes)
panels.description: Full-scene inference time of each variant next to FP32 on the same scenes and profile. Triplet rule (I-MOD-1): a variant is compared only with FP32 runs of the same scene (same image_hash) under the same constraint profile. Variants without such a pair produce no comparison.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
    SELECT
        image_hash,
        constraint_profile AS profile,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(compression_technique, ''), 'none') AS technique,
        AVG(inference_ms) AS inf_ms,
        AVG(peak_ram_mb) AS ram_mb,
        AVG(num_detections) AS dets,
        COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM execution_log
    WHERE trigger_type <> 'cue'
        AND status = 'success'
        AND image_hash <> 'pending'
        AND (notes IS NULL OR notes NOT LIKE '%methodology:pre-321de6b%')
        AND (LEFT('$profile', 1) = '$' OR '$profile' = 'all' OR constraint_profile = '$profile')
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
pairs AS (
    -- I-MOD-1: a variant is only compared with FP32 runs of the SAME scene
    -- (image_hash) under the SAME constraint profile.
    SELECT
        v.technique, v.profile, v.image_hash,
        v.n AS v_n, b.n AS b_n,
        v.inf_ms AS v_inf, b.inf_ms AS b_inf,
        v.ram_mb AS v_ram, b.ram_mb AS b_ram,
        v.dets AS v_dets, b.dets AS b_dets
    FROM runs v
    JOIN runs b
      ON b.image_hash = v.image_hash AND b.profile = v.profile AND b.technique = 'none'
    WHERE v.technique <> 'none'
)
SELECT
    technique || ' · ' || profile AS triplet,
    ROUND((AVG(b_inf) / 60000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "FP32 (min)",
    ROUND((AVG(v_inf) / 60000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Variant (min)"
FROM pairs
GROUP BY technique, profile
ORDER BY technique, profile

panels.title: Peak RAM: Variant vs FP32 on the Same Scenes (MB)
panels.description: Peak RSS during inference of each variant next to FP32 on the same scenes and profile. A smaller weight file does not imply less RAM: ONNX Runtime allocates its own buffers. panels.title: Model Size per Variant (MB)
panels.description: File size of each registered variant of the model under compression evaluation, with its registry status (models_registry).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN compression_technique = 'none' THEN 'fp32 (baseline)' ELSE compression_technique END
        || ' · ' || status AS variant,
    size_mb AS model_size_mb
FROM models_registry
WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM models_registry WHERE compression_technique <> 'none')
ORDER BY size_mb DESC
